concepts.learning_objective: Explain what the term agriculture covers, including its allied activities.
State the importance of agriculture to India's output, workforce and women workers.
Describe the archaeological evidence for early farming and intercropping in the Indian subcontinent.
Identify ancient Indian texts that record knowledge of agriculture, seeds and grafting.

topics.title: Climate, Seasons, and Crops
topics.ncert_sections: Climate, Seasons, and Crops; The monsoon and agriculture; The rhythm of seasons and crops

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how India's climatic diversity and agroclimatic zones guide what crops are grown.
Explain the role of the southwest and northeast monsoons in Indian farming.
Classify crops into the kharif, rabi and zaid cropping seasons.

topics.title: Soil, the Foundation of Cultivation
topics.ncert_sections: Soil, the Foundation of Cultivation; Soils of India; Soil-crop linkages

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how soil and humus are formed from rock and organic matter.
Distinguish the major soil types of India by their formation, properties and crops.
Explain traditional soil-care methods such as crop rotation, multiple cropping and contour ploughing.
Explain contemporary soil-conservation methods such as terracing and afforestation.

topics.title: Water and Seeds
topics.ncert_sections: Water: Rain-Fed vs. Irrigated Agriculture; Seeds

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish rain-fed agriculture from irrigated agriculture and their challenges.
Compare traditional irrigation systems with modern drip and sprinkler irrigation.
Explain traditional and modern seed practices and the issue of dependence on seed companies.

topics.title: Agricultural Practices: Traditional Wisdom and Modern Innovations
topics.ncert_sections: Traditional farming systems; Contemporary agriculture; Sustainable pathways

concepts.learning_objective: Describe traditional farming systems such as terrace farming, kulagar and gokrishi.
Evaluate the gains and the limits of the Green Revolution.
Explain how sustainable agriculture combines modern productivity with traditional practices.

topics.title: The Role of the Government and Challenges
topics.ncert_sections: The Role of the Government; Challenges

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how the government supports farmers with inputs, insurance and markets.
Analyse challenges such as small landholdings, climate change and stress on river basins.
